worked.prompt: Find the eigenvalues and one eigenvector for each of $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&0\\0&3\end{pmatrix}$.

parts.label: Solution
parts.a: The eigenvalues are $2$ and $3$, with respective eigenvectors $\begin{pmatrix}1\\0\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}0\\1\end{pmatrix}$.
